## Severity
- [ ] P0 - Blocker (breaks core pipeline, prevents CI or testing)
- [ ] P1 - High (major feature impaired, no simple workaround)
- [ ] P2 - Medium (moderate defect with workaround)
- [ ] P3 - Low (minor cosmetic, logging, or non-blocking issue)
